rules.description: Finder: F2 to rename, Return to open, Return/Esc to finish renaming
Use Backspace as Go to Previous Folder in Finder if not onedit
Mouse Shortcuts: Ctrl+Left to Copy, Ctrl+Right to Paste
MacBook keyboard: right_command = Sofle nav layer
MacBook keyboard: Caps Lock = right_command when held, caps_lock when tapped
